scope: Only native-execution-intent.test.ts; preserve prior domain and C04 import witnesses. No helper or production edits.
real_preconditions: Existing real issued Planner sources and persisted cases
Actual UI freshness and unassigned question preparation to verify selection; UI receipts remain UI
Existing installed catalog only; model absence remains availability observation
negative: A real issued source outside the selected case is refused by sf_question_prepare; no fabricated ACL/state/receipt.
native_witness: Bound successful native receipts in the actual Session plus decoded operation results for selected sources and current case; model creates its own question.
consumer_limit: IntentFrame is persisted and reopened by existing real HTTP consumer. The intermediate QuestionProposal is not claimed as a persisted native question contribution or human C06 consumption.

observations: Grants/scope and handler exports match actual capabilities.
Outside-case real source is refused by source-access-unavailable.
UI question preparation uses private Map and cases, requires no threads namespace or sending.
Native tool callIds are filtered by harness-attested run/session/principal receipts.
Decoded freshness covers both real selected references; question preserves case/version/source selection and no recipient.
Canonical required_operations remains the four-operation subset; the two additional routes are explicitly AM02.
